description: This file defines a React component 'SearchBar' that provides a user interface for filtering and triggering search actions based on multiple search criteria such as query, bed, status, surgeon, and case type. It manages internal state for the filters and calls the provided 'onSearch' callback with the current filters when the form is submitted.

methods.name: SearchBar
methods.description: React functional component that renders a search form with filter inputs and manages filter state. Calls 'onSearch' callback with filters on form submission.
